title: Shared-plan resource contention
objective: Warm competing slots; distinguish shared-plan pressure from real added compute.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: A modern browser with local JavaScript; no server, framework, account or cloud resources
One baseline 100-unit production worker; only explicit workers add modeled compute
Four fixed synthetic production journeys per run; no candidate exposure or attempted user migration
A dependency shared by production and all warming slots, even with separate compute plans
actions: Choose shared or separately provisioned candidate placement, bounded workers and competing slot demand
Declare production/warm-up budgets and choose complete or incomplete synthetic observations
Warm and measure once, inspect observed compute/headroom, readiness, journeys, gates and trace
Reset the current rehearsal with keyboard or pointer; preserve all earlier failures/unknowns and the six-run allowance

syntheticInputs.warmupLatencyMs: 100 + 2 * (warming plan compute excess + dependency excess) + 3 * zero-based slot index
syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory page session; reset preserves history and consumed allowance; reload starts a new lesson

expectedAssertions: Additional shared-plan slots increase overlap demand but never add compute
Explicit workers or an explicitly provisioned candidate plan add modeled compute
Sufficient shared overlap headroom or separately provisioned compute passes only complete synthetic acceptance gates
Separate plans do not isolate a shared dependency or guarantee independent fault domains
Known capacity/budget failures block admission; slow synthetic HTTP 200 journeys remain interruptions
Missing capacity, journey or warm-up observations cannot pass; known failures dominate uncertainty without discarding it
Production checks are not migrations; attempted and successful transitions stay zero and their rate stays unknown
Invalid inputs, forged state, duplicate measured actions and a seventh run cannot change retained evidence
Actual keyboard, reset, error focus, history, DOM results and CSP enforcement pass in the approved isolated browser
Normal verification preserves every owned byte; only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 deliberately captures browser evidence
limits: Capacity units, overload latency, HTTP responses, readiness and journeys are deterministic synthetic fixtures, not Azure measurements or limits
No actual App Service slot, warm-up, shared-plan, compute scaling, source-parent, fault-domain or five-nines certification
